","icon":"","option":"【一路平安。】"},"8gfxrw8wla9T1710863939170":{"dialogue":"

","icon":"","option":"【开场白】"},"mq5b574cmsdT1746631292978":{"dialogue":"

","icon":"","option":"【你们要去哪里？】"},"nqb471m7nmnT1710863941173":{"dialogue":"

","icon":"","option":"【你是？】"}}}]}
